# Unity examples

The upstream examples demonstrate different parts of the bridge. Generate the
required bindings before building an IL2CPP player. Hotfix examples additionally
require instrumentation; follow the [hotfix guide](hotfix.html).

| Example | Demonstrates |
| --- | --- |
| [Hello world](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/01_Helloworld) | Running Lua from C# |
| [Unity scripting](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/02_U3DScripting) | Lua implementations of Unity lifecycle callbacks |
| [UI events](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/03_UIEvent) | Lua callbacks for Unity UI buttons |
| [Lua objects](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/04_LuaObjectOrented) | Lua objects accessed through C# interfaces |
| [No GC](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/05_NoGc) | Generated conversions for value types |
| [Coroutines](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/06_Coroutine) | Lua and Unity coroutine integration |
| [Async calls](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/07_AsyncTest) | Sequential Lua logic over asynchronous callbacks |
| [Hotfixing](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/08_Hotfix) | Replacing instrumented C# behavior with Lua |
| [Generic methods](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/09_GenericMethod) | Supported generic method signatures |
| [Signature loader](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/10_SignatureLoader) | Loading signed Lua scripts |
| [Raw objects](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/11_RawObject) | Choosing boxed C# types for object parameters |
| [Lua implementations](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/12_ReImplementInLua) | Replacing struct operations and mappings in Lua |
| [CLI build](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/13_BuildFromCLI) | Invoking Unity builds from the command line |
| [Async hotfixing](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Examples/14_HotfixAsyncAwait) | Hotfixing async/task behavior |

The [tutorial source](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Assets/XLua/Tutorial) also includes C#-to-Lua and
Lua-to-C# call examples. See [test coverage](https://github.com/emindeniz99/xlua-ng/blob/main/Test/README.md) for what has been
verified on devices; an example's presence is not proof of every platform/runtime
combination. These are development examples, not a list of commercial adopters.
